title: Build scoped Git Hub requests
responsibility: Provide repository-scoped API requests, exact ref resolution and base64 conversion.

inputs.name: githubTransport.options
inputs.description: Repository identity, scoped token callback and optional fetch implementation.

inputs.name: githubTransport.permission
inputs.description: Contents permission requested for each token: read or write.

inputs.name: refPath.ref
inputs.description: Full heads, notes or tags ref with a safe path and valid ref characters.

inputs.name: readRef.client
inputs.description: Transport used to resolve the ref.

inputs.name: readRef.ref
inputs.description: Full ref to look up exactly, including notes refs.

inputs.name: exactRef.client
inputs.description: Transport used to require an existing exact ref.

inputs.name: base64.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to encode as standard base64.

inputs.name: decode64.value
inputs.description: Base64 text to decode; whitespace is ignored.

outputs.name: githubTransport
outputs.description: Request and repository-check methods; requests reject redirects and can return explicitly accepted statuses with null data.

outputs.name: refPath
outputs.description: Encoded API ref path with the refs/ prefix removed.

outputs.name: readRef
outputs.description: Exact matching ref SHA, or null for a missing ref.

outputs.name: exactRef
outputs.description: Exact matching ref SHA; a missing ref rejects.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid paths, refs or content, missing or mismatched refs, denied repository identity or privacy and unavailable GitHub requests.
